# FFmpeg

- What: FFmpeg's libavutil, libavcodec, libavformat and libswscale, trimmed to what the game's films need and built as one static library (`tpw_ffmpeg`) with the port: platform/quicktime.cpp plays the films with it (QuickTime movies with Sorenson Video 1 pictures and IMA4 sound, drawn as RGB24).
- Version: 9.0.2.
- Origin: https://ffmpeg.org/releases/ffmpeg-9.0.2.tar.xz
- Archive SHA-256: 8c3850283eb25fa026482078a04051e0be17347b09ef81a0849bec15a96e002e (ours: ffmpeg.org publishes no checksum for current releases, only the signature below).
- Signature: ffmpeg-9.0.2.tar.xz.asc from https://ffmpeg.org/releases/ verified with the FFmpeg release signing key (fingerprint FCF9 86EA 15E6 E293 A564 4F10 B432 2F04 D676 58D8, published at https://ffmpeg.org/ffmpeg-devel.asc): good signature, made 17 September 2026.
- Taken: 2026-10-21.
- License: LGPL version 2.1 or later (COPYING.LGPLv2.1 and LICENSE.md, as published). Every kept file is LGPL 2.1 or later by its own header, except libavutil/avsscanf.c (MIT, from musl, as LICENSE.md allows) and libswscale/uops_macros.h (generated by FFmpeg's own tools, no header of its own). No GPL, version 3 or nonfree file is here: none of the files LICENSE.md names as GPL, and no component that needs `--enable-gpl`, `--enable-version3` or `--enable-nonfree`.
- Kept, unchanged: the 140 C files CMakeLists.txt lists (the decoders svq1 and adpcm_ima_qt, the mov demuxer, the file protocol, the null bitstream filter, the swscale scaler, and the shared code a static link of those pulls in), the 7 C files they include (libavcodec/bit_depth_template.c, hpel_template.c, pel_template.c, libavfilter/framepool.c, libswscale/bayer_template.c, rgb2rgb_template.c, uops_tmpl.c), the 200 headers they include (among them compat/va_copy.h, libavfilter/framepool.h and the cpu.h headers of other architectures that libswscale/utils.c includes whatever the target), and COPYING.LGPLv2.1 and LICENSE.md; for Windows, libavutil/wchar_filename.h (included by libavutil/file_open.c and libavformat/os_support.h there, added 2026-10-22 from the same archive, its SHA-256 checked against the one above). 350 files of the archive's 10,399.
- Dropped: everything else in the archive: the other codecs, formats, protocols and filters, libavdevice, libavfilter (but framepool), libswresample, all assembly and every architecture's optimized C (no nasm, no intrinsics), fftools, doc, tests, tools, configure, the makefiles and ffbuild.
- Local change: no source file is changed. Ours, standing in for what FFmpeg's configure and makefiles would do (neither is here, neither is run): CMakeLists.txt (the static library target `tpw_ffmpeg`: the file list, configure's defines and optimization flags, no install rules, no probing of the host) and gen_config.py, which writes config/ (config.h, config_components.h, config/public/libavutil/avconfig.h and the six lists of registered components): only the components above, no assembly, no threads, no hardware decoding, no network, zlib as the only outside library (the game's own), and the C99 and POSIX functions macOS and Linux both have; on Windows (MinGW-w64), config.h sets the host's names to what FFmpeg's configure finds there instead (no POSIX memalign, mmap, strerror_r or clock_gettime; Win32 file paths, _aligned_malloc and GetSystemTimeAsFileTime). Run `python3 gen_config.py` after the kept file set changes; config/ is kept in the tree so that building needs no Python.
- Export: tpw-port only (the films are the port's; the translation does not play them).
